summary: Prompt 10 Lot 2 (DogAvatar + hover popup) and Lot 3 (dynamic WelcomeMessage) verified across the 3 roles on preview URL. Particulier (membre1.demo): 6 home-dog-avatar-<dogId> rendered on 'Mes chiens' section (all silhouettes — no dog photos on demo data, so home-dog-avatar-<id>-silhouette present, home-dog-avatar-<id>-photo absent — expected). Hover on avatar transitions popup (home-dog-avatar-<id>-popup) opacity 0->1 and back to 0 on mouse leave; popup shows dog name + breed ('Nikko [DEMO]' / 'Berger allemand'). welcome-message renders and rotates across 5 loads: 5 messages, 4 unique, all consecutive pairs different (no repeat 2x in a row), and dog name substitution ('votre chien' -> 'Nikko [DEMO]') works. Bureau (/admin/dashboard, Global): admin-welcome-message renders and rotates across reloads ('La patience...' -> 'Chaque balade...' -> 'Un chien heureux...'). Professionnel (pro2.demo): welcome-message renders on /pro/dashboard and rotates on reload; no home-dog-avatar (pro dashboard uses 'Mon chien' empty state art, no dog cards for this pro — no regression). All 3 dashboards load with no runtime/console errors after login; dog cards on member dashboard still show 'Suivi complet' link and upcoming participations; navigation unaffected. Empty encouragement path (dogName + empty) not directly reproducible because membre1 has demo dogs, but WelcomeMessage.jsx pick() logic returns encouragement string first when empty=true, and BaseHomeBlocks passes empty flag when no dogs+participations — code path confirmed by review, non-empty branch verified live and does not crash.

issues: welcome-message banner is rendered mid-page (between 'Autour du chien' block and 'Actualités' block) rather than literally at the very top of the home blocks. Visual placement is coherent with a warm 'quote of the day' aesthetic but does not match the wording 'top of the home blocks' in the spec — worth confirming with the product owner whether intended.

critical_code_review_comments: WelcomeMessage.pick uses sessionStorage 'vdc_welcome_last' with i = (i+1) % LIBRARY.length when i === last: guarantees no back-to-back duplicate within the same session, but two different components mounting on the same page (e.g. WelcomeMessage + admin-welcome-message across tabs) will read/write the same key; acceptable given they don't render simultaneously.

dogName substitution replaces both 'votre chien' and 'Votre chien' but leaves messages that contain 'son chien' untouched (e.g. 'Observer son chien'). Non-blocking, but personalisation is inconsistent across the 12 library entries.

DogAvatar wraps content in a <span> and uses inline-flex with nested <span> for the popup — the popup is fine visually, but leaving pointer-events-none on the tooltip means hovering the popup itself (e.g. to read a long referent) starts the fade-out. group-hover pattern currently keeps it open only while the trigger is hovered, which is acceptable for short content.
No admin/back-office CRUD for the welcome message library (as flagged in the request note — planned for later).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the reachable Lot 2 + Lot 3 scenarios
